message.content:
Here are some of the major airports in the United States, ranked by passenger traffic and overall importance:

| Airport | City / State | IATA Code | Notable Features |
|---------|--------------|-----------|------------------|
| Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta International Airport | Atlanta, GA | ATL | Largest airport in the world by passenger traffic; major hub for Delta Air Lines. |
| Los Angeles International Airport | Los Angeles, CA | LAX | Major gateway to Asia, Latin America, and the Pacific; busiest in the Western U.S. |
| Chicago O’Hare International Airport | Chicago, IL | ORD | One of the oldest major hubs; key hub for United Airlines and American Airlines. |
| Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport | Dallas–Fort Worth, TX | DFW | Largest airport in the U.S. by land area; major hub for American Airlines. |
| Denver International Airport | Denver, CO | DEN | Largest airport in the U.S. by land area; major hub for United and Southwest Airlines. |
| John F. Kennedy International Airport | New York City, NY | JFK | Major international gateway; hub for many carriers including Delta and JetBlue. |
| San Francisco International Airport | San Francisco, CA | SFO | Major hub for United and a key gateway to Asia. |
| Seattle–Tacoma International Airport | Seattle, WA | SEA | Major hub for Alaska Airlines and a growing hub for Delta. |
| Miami International Airport | Miami, FL | MIA | Major hub for international flights to Latin America and the Caribbean. |
| Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport | Phoenix, AZ | PHX | Major hub for American Airlines; high passenger volume in the Southwest. |
| Charlotte Douglas International Airport | Charlotte, NC | CLT | Major hub for American Airlines; one of the fastest-growing airports. |
| Orlando International Airport | Orlando, FL | MCO | Major hub for leisure travel; key hub for Southwest Airlines. |
| Newark Liberty International Airport | Newark, NJ | EWR | Major hub for United Airlines; important for international flights to Europe. |
| Washington Dulles International Airport | Washington, D.C. | IAD | Major hub for United Airlines; key for international flights to Europe and Asia. |

These airports are among the busiest in terms of passenger numbers, flight operations, and connectivity, serving as critical hubs for both domestic and international travel.
